statusDetail: Coverage-complete unauthenticated audit. Signed-in conversation history, paid subscription/checkout, generated response states, and destructive account actions were excluded because they require credentials or commitments.

page.framework: Angular app entry; related release-notes route redirects to a separate React-like gemini.google property; FAQ redirects to Google Help.
page.notes: Public AI assistant with app, download, release-note, help, localization, consent, and Google Accounts sign-in surfaces.

checkOutcomes.method: Screenshots and computed-style probe under light and dark emulation
checkOutcomes.evidence: Light emulation produced rgb(253,252,252) and a light-theme body; dark emulation produced the dark surface, so the page follows the system scheme.
Ten animations remained running under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, including morph, scale, sweep, rotate, and gradient loops with 4.3s to 1,498.5s durations.

checkOutcomes.method: Screenshot under prefers-contrast: more and forced-colors: active
checkOutcomes.evidence: Forced-colors/high-contrast capture preserves text, controls, borders, icons, and links.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS feature scan plus transition recording
checkOutcomes.evidence: Rendered DOM/CSS evidence contains no view-transition declarations for accessible state/navigation changes; navigation is implemented without the modern transition primitive.
No scroll-linked parallax, scrollytelling, carousel, or reveal interaction was present on the audited Gemini app entry surface.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scroll-linked parallax, scrollytelling, carousel, or reveal interaction was present on the audited Gemini app entry surface.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No swipe, pull-to-reveal, removable list, or other physical gesture surface was available in the signed-out representative flow.
checkOutcomes.reason: No swipe, pull-to-reveal, removable list, or other physical gesture surface was available in the signed-out representative flow.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The signed-out app entry is a single-viewport prompt surface; the long release-notes route redirects to a separate gemini.google origin and was treated as a related path, not app chrome.
checkOutcomes.reason: The signed-out app entry is a single-viewport prompt surface; the long release-notes route redirects to a separate gemini.google origin and was treated as a related path, not app chrome.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip or edge-positioned popover was exposed in the signed-out primary flow; the consent surface is a modal dialog, not an anchored transient overlay.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip or edge-positioned popover was exposed in the signed-out primary flow; the consent surface is a modal dialog, not an anchored transient overlay.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Entry, download, help, release-notes, and sign-in screenshots each expose a clear heading and visually dominant next control.
On first load the consent dialog obscures the primary prompt; at 360x800 it fills almost the entire viewport and initially exposes only “Read more”, not the accept/reject controls.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/runtime dialog probe and Lighthouse accessibility audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The consent UI is a custom MAT-DIALOG-CONTAINER with role=dialog, aria-modal=false, and no accessible name, despite visually blocking the app.
Behind the consent layer the signed-out app devotes the viewport to a single prompt composer and minimal navigation; download and help pages retain clear content hierarchy.
At 360x800 the app and release notes reported 0px horizontal overflow, valid viewport metadata, and mobile-specific layout.

checkOutcomes.method: CSSOM feature probe and cross-viewport screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Runtime CSS inspection found a container rule, and app/download controls reflow from wide to narrow captures without overflow.
The target probe found multiple actionable links only 17–18px high and a “More options” button 22px high, below robust touch-target expectations.
The H1 “Meet Gemini, your personal AI assistant” and prominently labelled prompt textbox communicate purpose and next action.

checkOutcomes.method: Prompt-flow DOM probe and first-load screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: The representative signed-out prompt flow cannot begin until the full-screen consent layer is expanded and answered; the core composer is visibly present but blocked.
Sign-in state, model selection, disabled/open sidebar states, AI accuracy disclaimer, and explicit consent choices are visibly labelled.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse mobile run corroborated by DevTools trace
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 28.5s, FCP 6.7s, TBT 940ms, Speed Index 11.5s, and performance score 0.35; a separate trace measured LCP 2.32s, showing strong condition sensitivity but confirming the throttled experience is poor.
Lighthouse CLS was 0.002 and the mobile layout observer measured 0.048, both within the good range; release notes measured zero shift.
Lighthouse reported 4.2s main-thread work, 2.1s JavaScript execution, and 940ms TBT; the trace also recorded three long tasks and 48ms TBT.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary, DOM script-attribute confirmation, and Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: Initial load transferred 5.33MB across 95 requests, including 3.71MB scripts and 1.37MB fonts; Lighthouse found redirect, document-latency, cache, font-display, and dependency-tree opportunities.
Lighthouse estimated 1,106KiB unused JavaScript and 58KiB unused CSS on the signed-out entry surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audits and runtime dialog probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found the role=dialog surface has no accessible name and a visible-label/accessibility-name mismatch.
Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.96 without a contrast failure, and forced-colors capture retained readable text/control boundaries.

checkOutcomes.method: Heading/control DOM probe and programmatic focus walk
checkOutcomes.evidence: The app exposes H1s and named controls; keyboard focus probes show UA or custom focus outlines on the tested menu, tool, link, language, and consent controls.
Across desktop, 360px mobile, Arabic RTL, download, help, and release-notes captures, text remains unclipped and readable with clear line spacing.
Viewport metadata does not disable scaling and 360px layouts reflow without horizontal overflow; no essential audio/video content was present on the audited surfaces.
Lighthouse best-practices scored 1.00 and did not report browser errors or uncaught exceptions.
The document has HTML doctype and UTF-8, but all five img elements lack width/height attributes and one visible SVG is delivered at 150px intrinsic width for a 40px display.
Lighthouse reports three reasons preventing back/forward cache restoration, despite the overall best-practices category passing.
The entry has title “Google Gemini” and a descriptive meta description; download and release notes provide path-specific descriptions.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse, DOM links, robots.txt, and sitemap recon
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse SEO scored 1.00; viewport metadata is present, robots allows the root and download route, and crawlable policy/help links use real hrefs.

checkOutcomes.method: Header fetch, runtime canonical probe, robots.txt and sitemap recon
checkOutcomes.evidence: The root returned HTTP 200 with canonical https://gemini.google.com/, robots references a successful 315-URL sitemap, and locale/path variants are represented.
Entry and release-notes pages expose JSON-LD plus Open Graph metadata consistent with visible Gemini content.

HTTPS, CSP, nosniff, and X-Frame-Options are present, but the CSP permits unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval, HSTS and Referrer-Policy are absent, and GOOGLE_ABUSE_EXEMPTION is reported without Secure and with SameSite=None.

The consent surface offers Reject all; tracker matching found no known tracker domains. Eight service origins were contacted, all within Google-controlled infrastructure, so no independent leaky third party was demonstrated.

checkOutcomes.method: Runtime permission-resource probe and sign-in walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: No geolocation/notification request was observed on load; authentication hands off to Google Accounts over HTTPS, whose first step is clearly labelled.
Clickjacking and Trusted Types defenses are present, but HSTS and Referrer-Policy are absent and the broad CSP includes unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval.

checkOutcomes.method: Discoverability/no-JS primitive confirmed against rendered DOM
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw server HTML contains only 3% of rendered content words, no H1, and produces an almost blank crawler screenshot; the primary app content depends on JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: Cross-condition screenshots, layout probe, and repeated-state heap comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: App controls, consent layer, Arabic RTL layout, and 360px layouts rendered without clipping or horizontal overflow; repeated sidebar state changes did not increase heap totals.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM asset/manifest inspection and response headers
checkOutcomes.evidence: This app-like site exposes no web app manifest and the CSP sets manifest-src none; no installable/offline web fallback was found.
A representative unknown route returns a bare 404 page with “That’s all we know” and no retry, home, search, or recovery action.
The Arabic route sets lang=ar and dir=rtl, mirrors the layout, and has no horizontal overflow; English routes set appropriate en-US/en-GB language values.

checkOutcomes.method: Sitemap enumeration and localized rendered DOM
checkOutcomes.evidence: The sitemap publishes 63 locale variants for each major path and the Arabic UI is translated rather than merely relabelled at the document level.
No time-zone-sensitive event, appointment, deadline, or local-time transaction appears in the audited app entry, download, help, or release-note surfaces.
checkOutcomes.reason: No time-zone-sensitive event, appointment, deadline, or local-time transaction appears in the audited app entry, download, help, or release-note surfaces.

checkOutcomes.evidence: On mobile, consent choices are withheld behind “Read more” while the modal blocks the core product; users cannot initially choose Accept all or Reject all.
Gemini’s audited surfaces contain no conventional editable form with required/invalid submission states; the Google Accounts form is a separate origin and was not submitted.
checkOutcomes.reason: Gemini’s audited surfaces contain no conventional editable form with required/invalid submission states; the Google Accounts form is a separate origin and was not submitted.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The Gemini prompt is a free-form contenteditable, not an address, payment, sign-in, or sign-up field where autocomplete tokens apply.
checkOutcomes.reason: The Gemini prompt is a free-form contenteditable, not an address, payment, sign-in, or sign-up field where autocomplete tokens apply.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited account handoff clearly identifies Google sign-in, offers account creation and guest-mode guidance, and exposes privacy/terms links; no purchase or subscription commitment was entered.
Only 15.4KB of images transferred and three of five image resources use modern SVG; the one PNG is a 24px brand mark.
A nearly empty signed-out prompt surface transfers 5.33MB, including 3.71MB scripts and 1.37MB fonts, before the user performs a task.
70 of 95 initial requests and 5.19MB of 5.33MB are classified off the gemini.google.com origin; Google-owned gemini.gstatic.com and fonts.gstatic.com dominate bytes.

WebMCP is emerging and no explicit agent-facing scope is declared. A probe found no navigator MCP surface or registered machine-readable tools, so this is recorded as an opportunity rather than a failure.
checkOutcomes.reason: WebMCP is emerging and no explicit agent-facing scope is declared. A probe found no navigator MCP surface or registered machine-readable tools, so this is recorded as an opportunity rather than a failure.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Gemini is itself a server-backed AI product, but no audited user task established a need for browser built-in on-device LanguageModel or Summarizer APIs.
checkOutcomes.reason: Gemini is itself a server-backed AI product, but no audited user task established a need for browser built-in on-device LanguageModel or Summarizer APIs.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten representative sidebar open/close attempts, heap nodes fell from 1,193,867 to 1,186,030 and self size fell from 66.39MB to 65.37MB; no retained-growth signal was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap totals judged against visible surface and HAR
checkOutcomes.evidence: The signed-out entry retains about 65–66MB across roughly 1.19M V8 heap nodes before a conversation begins, disproportionate to the visible single prompt surface and consistent with the 5.33MB/46-script load.
No Detached* constructor appears among top retained constructors; closure count fell from 111,177 to 109,746 after repeated interaction and overall heap totals decreased.

principleOutcomes.reason: WebMCP is emerging and no explicit agent-facing scope is declared. A probe found no navigator MCP surface or registered machine-readable tools, so this is recorded as an opportunity rather than a failure.

paths.description: Signed-out Gemini app entry and prompt composer; primary app archetype.
Signed-out app at 360x800; mobile form-factor and consent path.
Native-app download landing page; promotional/detail archetype.
Updates listing/content archetype; redirects to gemini.google/release-notes/.
Arabic localized app variant representing RTL and localization.
Google Accounts handoff representing authentication entry; stopped before credential submission.
Unknown route representing HTTP/navigation failure recovery.
FAQ/help route; redirects to Google Help and represents support/search.

findings.summary: Motion preference is ignored
findings.evidence: The decorative Gemini background keeps ten long-running morph/scale/sweep/rotate animations active under reduced motion.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential animations with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), stopping or simplifying looping motion.

findings.summary: State changes do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no view-transition declarations on the app entry.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt same-document View Transitions for major sidebar, picker, and route state swaps, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.guidanceId: avoid intrusive interstitial popup content first
findings.summary: Consent blocks the product on first load
findings.evidence: The first-load consent dialog covers the prompt and nearly fills the 360x800 viewport; accept/reject are initially below the collapsed disclosure.
findings.suggestedFix: Present essential consent choices without obscuring the core page, or use a compact, immediately dismissible consent surface.

findings.summary: Consent dialog semantics do not match its modal behavior
findings.evidence: The custom MAT-DIALOG-CONTAINER has role=dialog, aria-modal=false, and no accessible name while visually blocking interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog where possible, set a programmatic name, preserve focus, and make modal semantics agree with behavior.

findings.summary: Several targets are too short for dependable touch use
findings.evidence: Rendered targets include policy links at 17–18px high and More options at 22px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase the clickable box with padding/min-block-size while retaining the compact visual label.

findings.summary: Consent adds a blocking detour to the primary prompt flow
findings.evidence: The visible composer cannot be used until a full-screen disclosure is expanded and answered.
findings.suggestedFix: Make reject/accept immediately available and keep the primary product understandable and reachable without an unnecessary disclosure step.

findings.summary: Throttled mobile load misses the Core Web Vitals performance bar
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 28.5s LCP, 6.7s FCP, 940ms TBT, and a 0.35 performance score.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP content, remove redirect/document latency, and defer non-critical code until after the first useful render.

findings.summary: JavaScript keeps the main thread busy during startup
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 4.2s main-thread work and 2.1s script execution; trace evidence also contains long tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Break up startup tasks, schedule by priority, and lazy-load capabilities not needed for the signed-out prompt.

findings.summary: Critical resource delivery is too heavy and delayed
findings.evidence: The page makes 95 requests for 5.33MB, including 46 scripts and 1.37MB fonts; Lighthouse flags redirect, font, cache, and dependency issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten the critical chain, subset/preload only essential fonts, remove redirect latency, and defer non-critical bundles.

findings.summary: Large unused CSS and JavaScript ship on the entry surface
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 1,106KiB unused JavaScript and 58KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Split bundles by capability and conditionally load signed-in/editor features only when needed.

findings.summary: The blocking dialog lacks a reliable accessible name
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails aria-dialog-name and label-content-name-mismatch on the primary first-load state.
findings.suggestedFix: Name the dialog from its visible heading and align each visible label with the computed accessible name.

findings.summary: Image elements omit intrinsic dimensions
findings.evidence: The image primitive reports width and height missing from all five img elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width/height or equivalent aspect-ratio reservation to each image; retain empty alt for decorative images.

findings.summary: The page is not eligible for reliable BFCache restoration
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three BFCache failure reasons.
findings.suggestedFix: Inspect the BFCache failure details, remove avoidable blockers, and preserve app state across pagehide/pageshow.

findings.summary: Defensive response policy has material gaps
findings.evidence: HSTS and Referrer-Policy are absent, CSP permits unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval, and one SameSite=None cookie is reported without Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS and a strict Referrer-Policy, tighten CSP toward nonces/strict-dynamic without unsafe-eval, and secure every SameSite=None cookie.

findings.summary: Primary content is an almost empty no-JavaScript shell
findings.evidence: Only 3% of rendered content words occur in raw HTML; no H1 survives and crawler capture is nearly blank.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the purpose, prompt affordance explanation, headings, and crawlable navigation, then hydrate the interactive app.

findings.guidanceId: offline fallback service worker web app manifest installable pwa
findings.summary: The web app has no installable or offline fallback
findings.evidence: No manifest is linked and policy explicitly sets manifest-src none.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a web app manifest and a minimal offline/error fallback for the app shell, while keeping network-only AI actions explicit.

findings.guidanceId: http error network failure timeout retry stale data resilient state
findings.summary: Unknown routes offer no recovery action
findings.evidence: The bare 404 page says “That’s all we know” with no home, search, retry, or support link.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded resilient error state with a home/app link, help/search, and retry guidance.

findings.summary: Consent choices are initially hidden behind disclosure
findings.evidence: At 360x800 only Read more is visible; Reject all and Accept all require expansion while the app is blocked.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose equally prominent accept and reject actions in the initial consent state and keep further detail optional.

findings.summary: Startup work is disproportionate to the signed-out surface
findings.evidence: The blank prompt entry transfers 5.33MB before interaction, mostly JavaScript and fonts.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a signed-out page-weight budget and defer model, editor, upload, and account capabilities until invoked.

findings.summary: Cross-origin service assets dominate the load budget
findings.evidence: 70/95 requests and 5.19MB are outside the page origin, even though they are Google-controlled service origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate and cache origin dependencies, subset fonts, and load optional service integrations only after intent.

findings.summary: Initial heap footprint is high for a one-control entry state
findings.evidence: Heap summaries retain about 65–66MB and 1.19M V8 nodes before any conversation.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile startup retainers, remove unused feature graphs from the signed-out bundle, and lazy-initialize heavy services.
